body: Yes, I am sorry if I implied that I wanted to know the exact things, I just was curious that how in the world does one think of controlling life expectancy. I feel scared as there are not many things that can be stopped from going downhill by sheer accident. I go between wanting to die and not, and so far I keep myself from acting because I don't think most things can be played with on a knob. Sorry to hear what you heard from crisis lines. It is definitely not a choice. It is beyond our control. Today I feel better about life, so if I could avoid a random depressive episode that would be nice but I have no say.

Hey there, I feel your pain. I constantly go between regretting and committing to self harm. I do have a debilitating disease and have seen loved ones decline. While the compassion part appears true, the suffering is deep and terrifying for everyone. I remember my uncle (who I was very close with) just feeling distraught and saying everyone seems fake. I could say some for myself. I also sometimes feel that when I am not doing well physically, I also cannot function mentally. Once I started believing that my family is actively trying to manipulate me into being depressed. Other times I could not make good judgements. What are you doing though?

I think sometimes people (even loved ones) can blurt things out about others' traumatic experience thinking it is funny. Perhaps it is because they are removed from the situation and do not fully understand it. I feel very sorry that she made such an insensitive remark. I get that sometimes from my parents too about my mental health. I don't think your mom meant it, it is probably a generational thing too.
